name: PETRONAS Kasawari CCS (Block SK316, offshore Sarawak)

sources.note: The Star, PETRONAS seeks to bring forward first CO2 injection at Kasawari to 2027, 1 April 2026 (read 28 October 2026); FID from Oil & Gas Journal

source.note: The Star, PETRONAS seeks to bring forward first CO2 injection at Kasawari to 2027, 1 April 2026 (read 28 October 2026); FID from Oil & Gas Journal

notes: Status per card source: FID 20 October 2022; the Kasawari gas field began production in August 2024, but CO2 injection had not started as of April 2026 — PETRONAS said on 1 April 2026 it is looking to bring the first CO2 injection forward to as early as 2027, from a previous projection of end-2029/early 2030; the 2025 and end-2025 start-up dates cited in earlier sources did not materialise
